correctness.rationale: The exact four-state star generator has p0'(t) equal to signed load particle current. Finite positive Fermi rates yield reversible equilibrium pi0=1/Z→0, so the long-first order of limits is -p0. Perturbation of H_delta gives |u_g|²,|u_e|²∼Omega²/(2delta²), |u_d|²→1, while mu tracks E_d. Fast (0,d) equilibration gives p0=(1-f)m; Schur-complement time rescaling theta=Gamma Omega² t/delta² gives m'=-(1-f)m and p0=(1-f)m exp(-(1-f)theta). Opposite limiting signs require (1-f)m>p0; strict monotonicity produces theta*=log((1-f)m/p0)/(1-f). The proof only claims a zero on this scale, not uniqueness at all finite detunings. Independent matrix-exponential root checks delta=100 and 500 approach theta*=0.9325745932.
residual_risks: No proof of all-time physical device performance beyond one-electron secular idealization; finite checks alone not infinite proof.
